articles.summary: WILMINGTON, Mass. , Jan. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Analog Devices, Inc. (Nasdaq: ADI) today announced the appointment of Dr. Yoky Matsuoka to its Board of Directors as an independent director and member of the Board's Corporate Development Committee effective January 20, 2026 . Dr.
articles.title: Analog Devices Appoints Yoky Matsuoka to its Board of Directors
